summary:
Space Mission Design Game is an interactive space adventure that makes learning about space exploration fun and simple for students and space enthusiasts.
Players start on a galaxy-themed screen and meet an astronaut guide who asks for their name, turning every player into a crew member on a personal mission. A mission control menu lets them explore planets, pick a mini-game, or jump into the rescue challenge, with a home button on every screen for easy navigation. 
In “Save the Space Ship,” players pick floating objects before they touch the sides of the satellite, while a live score tracks their progress. This builds quick reactions and focus, just like real missions that depend on fast decisions.
In “Life on the Station,” players collect floating items such as toothpaste, soap and a toothbrush inside a space station while racing a timer. It shows how everyday routines change in zero gravity.
By turning space mission challenges into quick, playful activities, the game builds curiosity about planets, spacecraft and life in space for players of every age, inspiring the next generation to explore the next frontier.
